textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component:setColor(0.9, 0.9, 0.9) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.25*game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED)
local text = LOC(game.objectDescription())
if game.isBattleTrophy() then local campaignTitle = LOC(game.battleTrophyInfo()) text = text:gsub("%${CAMPAIGN}", campaignTitle) end
local selectedObject = game.SelectedObject() if selectedObject and selectedObject:isAwakener() then -- display a different bio if completed local calendarId = game.player():getDailyCumulativeLogin():calendar() if calendarId > selectedObject:getCalendarId() then local replacementId = game.objectDescription() .. "_" .. tostring(selectedObject:getCalendarId()) if LOC(replacementId) ~= replacementId then text = LOC(replacementId) end end end
if (selectedObject and selectedObject:isMonster()) then local selectedMonsterId = game.selectedMonsterId(); local discoveredByText = game.monsterUidDiscoveredBy(selectedMonsterId) if (discoveredByText ~= "") then text = text .. "\n\n" .. LOC("DISCOVERED_BY_LABEL") .. "\n" text = text:gsub("%${PLAYER_NAME}", discoveredByText) end end
component("text"):SetString(text) component("layer"):SetString("Clipping")

element.name: InfoLikes

swipeComponent.name: Swiper
swipeComponent.event:
component:V("direction"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuSwipeComponent_SwipeDirectionHorizontal) component:V("mode"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuSwipeComponent_SwipeModeFree) component:V("tSteps"):SetFloat(25.0) component:listenToTouches(element)
local numItems = element.Entries.NumLikes
if numItems > 0 then local itemWidth = element.Entries:E("likeEntry0"):absW()
if(numItems * itemWidth > element:absW()) then component:setScrollSize((numItems*itemWidth)-element:absW()) else component:setScrollSize(0) end end

local first = element.Entries
if(first) then local offset = component:scrollOffset() if(first:getOrientationPosition().x ~= offset and element.Entries:E("likeEntry1") ~= nil) then first:setOrientationPosition(Vector2(offset, first("yOffset"):GetInt())) end end

element.name: Entries
element.event:
local likes = game.getLikes(game.selectedMonsterTypeId()) local numLikes = likes:size() local previous = nil local likeEntry = nil
element.NumLikes = numLikes
local entryWidth = 105*game.menuScaleX()
for i=0,numLikes-1 do
local yOffset = 0 local entityId = likes[i]
if(i==(numLikes-1)) then likeEntry = menu:addTemplateElement("template_mysterylike", "likeEntry"..i, element) likeEntry.alternateText = i else likeEntry = menu:addTemplateElement("template_likesentry", "likeEntry"..i, element) likeEntry.AnimFile = game.entityAnimFile(entityId) if(game.IsBoxFromEntityId(entityId)) then
if(not game.isAmberIsland()) then likeEntry.AnimName = "Idle" yOffset = 40*game.hudScale() else likeEntry.AnimName = "Store" end else likeEntry.AnimName = game.entityAnimName(entityId) end --likeEntry.ObjName = game.entityName(entityId) likeEntry.EntityId = entityId end
likeEntry:relativeTo(element) likeEntry:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(7*game.hudScale() + (i*entryWidth), yOffset, -1, lua_sys.LEFT, lua_sys.TOP)) likeEntry:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.LEFT, lua_sys.TOP)
previous = likeEntry
likeEntry:init() likeEntry:setPositionBroadcast(true) end

element.Touch:V("enabled"):SetInt(1)
local numLikes = element.Entries.NumLikes for i=0,numLikes-1 do element.Entries:E("likeEntry"..i):DoStoredScript("show") end

element.Touch:V("enabled"):SetInt(0)
local numLikes = element.Entries.NumLikes for i=0,numLikes-1 do element.Entries:E("likeEntry"..i):DoStoredScript("hide") end

element.name: ImageTitle
element.event: element:SetupGenericListener( game.engineReceiver(), "game::msg::MsgRequestNameMonster", "gotMsgRequestNameMonster" ) if(game.selectedObjType() ~= game.SpecificEntityType_MONSTER) then element.Touch:V("enabled"):SetInt(0) element.Sprite:V("visible"):SetInt(0) end

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
if(game.selectedObjIsMonster()) then component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("noTranslate"):SetInt(1) else component("multiline"):SetInt(1) end
component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("size"):SetFloat(0.35*game.hudScale()) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED)
local selectedObject = game.SelectedObject()
if game.isBattleTrophy() then local text = LOC(game.objectName()) local campaignTitle = LOC(game.battleTrophyInfo()) text = text:gsub("%${CAMPAIGN}", campaignTitle) component("text"):SetString(text) elseif selectedObject and selectedObject:isAwakener() then -- special hack for Awakener to show deactivated name local calendarId = game.player():getDailyCumulativeLogin():calendar() if calendarId <= selectedObject:getCalendarId() then -- show deactivated name local textId = "STRUCTURE_AWAKENER_DEACTIVATED" component("text"):SetString(textId) else -- show regular name component("text"):SetString(game.objectName()) end else component("text"):SetString(game.objectName()) end
component("layer"):SetString("PopUps")

element.name: StatsList
element.event:
element.NumStats = 0
local objType = game.selectedObjType()
if(game.isObjectSelected()) then if(objType == game.SpecificEntityType_MONSTER) then local monster = game.SelectedObject() if(monster:isTitansoul()) then element:parent():populateTitansoulStats() else element:populateMonsterStats() element:SetupGenericListener(game.engineReceiver(), "game::msg::MsgMonsterUpdated", "gotMsgMonsterUpdated") end elseif(objType == game.SpecificEntityType_BAKERY) then element:parent():populateBakeryStats() elseif(objType == game.SpecificEntityType_BREEDING) then element:parent():populateBreedingStats() elseif(objType == game.SpecificEntityType_NURSERY) then element:parent():populateNurseryStats() elseif(objType == game.SpecificEntityType_CASTLE) then element:populateCastleStats() elseif(objType == game.SpecificEntityType_MINE) then element:parent():populateMineStats() elseif(objType == game.SpecificEntityType_FUZER) then element:parent():populateFuzerStats() else element:parent().BlackCover.Sprite:V("height"):SetInt(0) local fader = element:parent().FadeSprite.Sprite local faderSize = fader:size() fader:setSize(lua_sys.Vector2(faderSize.x, faderSize.y + 46*game.windowScaleY())) end end

local previous = nil local statsArray = nil if(not game.isEtherealIslet()) then statsArray = { "template_stat_species", "template_stat_class", "template_stat_beds", "template_stat_coinrate", "template_stat_maxcoins", "template_stat_sellprice" } else statsArray = { "template_stat_species", "template_stat_class", "template_stat_coinrate", "template_stat_maxcoins", "template_stat_sellprice" } end
element:populateStatsArr(statsArray)

template.name: BioButton
template.event:
local objType = game.selectedObjType()
if((game.onTribalIsland() == true) or ((objType ~= game.SpecificEntityType_MONSTER) and (objType ~= game.SpecificEntityType_CASTLE))) then element:setInvisible() elseif(objType == game.SpecificEntityType_CASTLE or game.SelectedObject():isTitansoul()) then element:V("xOffset"):SetInt(20*game.menuScaleX()) end

textComponent.event: local txt = game.getLocalizedText("LIKES") local x, y = txt:find("%s") if(x == nil) then component("multiline"):SetInt(0) else component("multiline"):SetInt(1) end component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.3*game.hudScale()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString("LIKES") component("layer"):SetString("ContextBar")

template.event:
local objType = game.selectedObjType()
if(objType ~= game.SpecificEntityType_MONSTER or game.selectedMonsterHasLikes() == false or game.hideMonsterLikes() == true) then element:setInvisible() element.Label:V("visible"):SetInt(0) end
